events.title: Diamondback Energy Hiking Shale Output. Oil Stocks Skid On Earnings.
events.body: Diamondback Energy gave positive guidance late Monday after beating earnings estimates for the first quarter. The oil stock fell Tuesday after hitting a new high. Tidewater and Transocean gave mixed reports.

events.title: Valaris Limited (VAL) Reports Q1 Loss, Beats Revenue Estimates
events.body: Valaris (VAL) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -380.00% and +6.29%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
